summary_en: Uses paired optical-camera and sonar images during training to improve sonar-only underwater object detection. A YOLOX-based Cross-Model Object-Level Distillation module transfers object-level semantic knowledge from the camera teacher to the sonar student while accounting for heterogeneous modality structure. It is directly relevant to camera-sonar fusion, but is best treated as core-adjacent because the main contribution is training-time cross-modal distillation for detection rather than joint image formation or reconstruction.
